senses.sense_definition: A small oyster from the eastern coast of the United States.

examples.text: The restaurant is famous for serving fresh <w>bluepoint</w> oysters on the half shell.
We ordered a dozen <w>bluepoint</w> oysters as an appetizer before the main course.

senses.sense_definition: A cat breed with a light-colored body and blue-toned markings on its face, ears, tail, and paws.

examples.text: The <w>bluepoint</w> Siamese cat has striking blue eyes and dark grey points.
She adopted a beautiful <w>bluepoint</w> kitten from the local animal shelter.
